summary.intent: Fix failing desktop E2E tests on main after the FUSE mount / phase-54 migration changes.
summary.outcome: Root cause identified as missing workspace package.json files in tests/desktop-e2e and tests/e2e-helpers — two new package.json files were added, pnpm install run, lockfile updated and prettier-reformatted, fix committed and pushed.

repo: Desktop E2E CI runs on main push, NOT on PRs — so breaking changes merged via PR only surface after the fact on main.

All tests/* E2E suites that use @cipherbox/* workspace packages must be declared as workspace packages themselves (with a package.json listing those deps); resolution at runtime under tsx requires real node_modules symlinks, not just tsconfig paths.
tsconfig.scripts.json paths mappings are typecheck-only; tsx reads tsconfig.json at runtime, so bare @cipherbox/* specifiers fail from directories that are not workspace packages.
The repo runs prettier on pnpm-lock.yaml; pnpm install rewrites it in compact format which produces ~5k lines of diff churn — must re-run prettier on the lockfile before committing.
Established convention: test workspace packages are private, declare type:module, version 0.0.0, and list @cipherbox/* deps as devDependencies.
tests/desktop-e2e needs @cipherbox/sdk-core and @cipherbox/crypto; tests/e2e-helpers needs @cipherbox/api-client and @cipherbox/sdk-core.

code.finding: Phase-54 rewrote this from curl-based to SDK-based (imports @cipherbox/sdk-core and @cipherbox/crypto) — the old curl approach got 400s, so it now republishes via SDK. This import is what broke resolution.

Imports @cipherbox/api-client; transitively loaded by verify-filepointer.ts via test-move-content.ts spawning it, so all round-trip and move-content scenarios depend on e2e-helpers being a proper workspace package.

workflow: gh run download + local grep is the fastest path to extracted log content when gh run view --log-failed returns empty (step-level failures don't always populate --log-failed).
When a lockfile diff is unexpectedly large, check formatting: pnpm compact vs prettier expanded format can produce thousands of lines of cosmetic churn with zero semantic change.
Verify module resolution by running the actual script against a dummy URL — ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND vs fetch failed is a clean signal that imports resolved correctly.

friction: gh run view --log-failed returned empty despite a clear runtime failure — had to download the full 4766-line log and grep manually.
FUSE log spam in the CI artifact dominated grep output, masking the real test-runner error lines.
pnpm install silently reformatted pnpm-lock.yaml from prettier format to compact format, causing a misleading -5116 line diff that required investigation before it was safe to commit.
Phase-54 PR (#532) passed its own PR CI (which doesn't run desktop E2E) and only broke on main push — no early signal.
open_items: The desktop E2E suite only runs on main push — consider adding a path-filtered PR trigger for tests/desktop-e2e/** changes so regressions surface before merge.
The tsconfig.scripts.json paths-only approach is fragile for runtime use; worth documenting or enforcing (e.g. a lint rule) that scripts in workspace subdirs must be in a package.
